balances.description: The accounts marked revalue with a foreign-currency balance at the period end, by account and currency.

date.description: The revaluation's date: the period's last day.

latest.description: The period's latest run, if any.

lines.description: What a run would post now: a base-only line per item that changes, and the losses and gains on the unrealised-FX account. Empty when nothing changes or a rate is missing.

missing.description: Currencies with no rate on the period's last day: nothing posts until each has one (FX-01).

not_revalued.description: Foreign-currency balances on accounts not marked revalue, which keep the rates they were recorded at.

reverse_on.description: The day its entry reverses: the next period's first.

state.description: nothing: no foreign-currency balance on an account marked revalue; due: no run yet, or a posting dated in or before the period came after the latest (the close refuses it); revalued: the latest run is current.
